evals.prompt: Find me NNN retail properties for sale in Madison, WI under $2M with a cap rate above 6%.
evals.expected_output: One merged table drawing from Crexi, LoopNet, and PropertyDrive; 2250 Pennsylvania Ave deduped across sites with all source links; cap rate shown (8.23% from LoopNet); NNN handled via LoopNet path filter + post-filter elsewhere, not via Crexi URL lease filter.
assertions: Finds 2250 Pennsylvania Ave at $1,350,000 with 8.23% cap rate
Finds 2008 Fish Hatchery Rd at $1,195,000 (~7.95% cap, Crexi-only listing)
2250 Pennsylvania Ave is presented as ONE row/entry attributed to multiple sites (deduped), not repeated per site
Listings with undisclosed cap or lease type are shown as n/a or near-misses rather than silently dropped
Every listed property links to its source listing page(s)

evals.prompt: What industrial buildings are for sale in Milwaukee between $1M and $3M? Check Crexi and LoopNet.
evals.expected_output: Correct market/type/price translation for both named sites; PropertyDrive either included as a bonus (Milwaukee is in its coverage) or its omission noted; results table with source links.
assertions: Both Crexi and LoopNet were searched with industrial type and $1M-$3M price filters applied
Cross-listed properties are merged into single entries carrying both source links
5201 W Clinton Ave (6.00% cap, ~$1.38M) appears in the results
Output is one merged table (not two separate per-site lists) with clickable source links

evals.prompt: I've got a 1031 buyer looking for multifamily in Madison, budget around $1.5M — what's on the market right now?
evals.expected_output: Vague budget interpreted as a sensible band (~$1M-$2M) and stated; multifamily searched on all three sites; deduped table sorted by price; notes explain interpretation.
assertions: The vague 'around $1.5M' budget is translated into an explicit price band that is stated in the output
25 Coronado Ct is found and deduped across Crexi and LoopNet into one entry
All three sites (Crexi, LoopNet, PropertyDrive) are searched, or any skipped site is named with a reason
PropertyDrive-only listing 736 E Johnson St is surfaced (coverage the national sites miss)
Results form a single table with per-listing source links
